description:
pkix-revocation::Error was given #[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)] in commit ddb474d6 but not Eq.

All variants of pkix-revocation::Error contain only types that implement Eq:
- der::Error: #[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
- SerialNumber: #[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, ...)]
- CrlReason: #[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, Enumerated)]
- All other variants are fieldless or contain only these types.

Since PartialEq is reflexive (a == a) for all these types, the derived PartialEq IS Eq semantics already — the missing Eq derive is a minor inconsistency that prevents callers from using Error in HashSet or as a HashMap key.

Fix: add Eq to the derive list for pkix_revocation::Error.
title: pkix-revocation::Error derives PartialEq but not Eq despite all variants supporting Eq
